newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Svyazinvest to take over Rostelekom shares - Centre.
newsitem.headline: Svyazinvest to take over Rostelekom shares - Centre.

text.p: Russian state telecoms holding company AO Svyazinvest will take over part of national telecoms group Rostelekom's shares under a planned merger of the two companies, a Russian Privatisation Centre spokeswoman said on Thursday.
"A part of Rostelekom's shares will be merged into Svyazinvest," Yelena Shalneva told Reuters.
She said the merger could take place in two weeks' time.
"The project is already ready, now we are working on the details. The merger could take place in two weeks' time," she said.
The privatisation centre, which had been handling the sale of a 25 percent stake in Svyazinvest to a strategic investor, had been working on the project for several months, she said.
